'''Range Adjusters''' were components fitted to the [[Scope/Legends|scope]] of a [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launcher]]. The [[FC-1 flechette launcher/Legends|FC-1 flechette launcher]] had two Range Adjusters accessible on the side of the scope.<ref name="EGWT" />
